panel.name: hyena_info_card
panel.text: Project Hyena

Project Hyena is an independent Second Life viewer built around a modern navy and cyan interface and smoother performance, paired with a companion launcher for quick sign-in and environment setup. Version: Alpha 0.1.0 (Early Build). Our GitHub page and Discord community are coming soon.
Release downloads and notes: GitHub page coming soon.

panel.name: hy_ov_1
panel.text: Project Focus & Objectives

Project Hyena is engineered to modernize and optimize the Second Life experience by streamlining environment management, launcher efficiency and everyday workflows. It builds on, and honors, the open-source viewer provided by Linden Lab.

panel.name: hy_ov_2
panel.text: What You Get

A modern, consistent navy-and-cyan interface across the whole viewer. Performance work on rendering, texture and mesh loading, and threading. A launcher that sets up and picks the right build for your PC. Everything you expect from a full-featured viewer, with a cleaner look and fewer distractions.

panel.name: hy_ov_3
panel.text: Early Build
Project Hyena is an early build. Features, layout and performance will keep changing between releases. Bug reports and feedback are welcome and help shape what comes next.

panel.label: SL Credits

sl_card_1
panel.text: Built on the Second Life Viewer

Project Hyena is built on the open-source architecture of the Second Life viewer, made freely available through Linden Lab's long-standing commitment to open-source development.
We are grateful to the platform creators, maintainers and community contributors who built the foundation this viewer stands on.
